desc: Serve up sweet joy for family and guests all season long with Betty Crocker Favorites Fudge Brownie Mix. Enjoy thick, fudgy brownies with an intense chocolate taste, minus all the work. This brownie mix goes from bowl to oven in minutes. Simply mix with water, oil, and eggs, then pour into a greased pan and bake. The result is ridiculously good fudge brownies everyone will enjoy. Use the fudge brownie mix as is or explore Betty Crocker recipes for a new take on this classic treat. Add brownies to your Thanksgiving food spread or serve alongside gingerbread cookies on your holiday dessert table. Make brownies part of food gifts for friends, teachers, or neighbors. Pack them in a baked goods gift basket or tasty care package. Add a couple of boxes to your list of baking needs to whip up easy treats for fall parties or winter gatherings. For more than a century, Betty Crocker has been a popular creator of easy, delicious recipes. Today, the Betty Crocker kitchen is still providing convenient, tasty dessert mixes, frostings, and convenient meal options and side dishes.
features:
• Rich Milk-Chocolate Flavor — Creates mouthwatering, family‑pleasing brownies perfect for gatherings and gifting 
  • Quick & Easy Prep — Just add water, oil, and eggs; bake in minutes from bowl to oven 
  • Consistently Moist & Chewy — Delivers a fudgy, tender interior that stays soft and crave‑worthy
  • Versatile for All Occasions — Ideal for holiday dessert tables, party treats, and thoughtful baked‑goods gifts
ingredients: Sugar, Enriched Flour Bleached (wheat flour, niacin, iron, thiamin mononitrate, riboflavin, folic acid), Cocoa Processed with Alkali, Palm Oil, Corn Syrup. Contains 2% or less of: Corn Starch, Salt, Canola Oil, Carob Powder, Artificial Flavor.
